name: The Night Watch
summary: In Darkshire, Commander Althea Ebonlocke calls for help against the dead rising nearby. Stormwind’s garrison has left the town to its local militia, which depends on travelers to hold back the undead at Tranquil Gardens Cemetery.

sections.title: Abandoned by the Crown
sections.body: Stormwind once protected Duskwood, but royal resources ran thin and political discord gripped the capital. The crown withdrew its commissioned soldiers, leaving Darkshire largely defenseless against the forest’s encroaching shadows. The people formed the Night Watch, a local militia led by Commander Althea Ebonlocke. It stands between the cursed forest and the town’s remaining residents.

sections.title: Clearing the Tranquil Gardens
sections.body: South of Darkshire, Tranquil Gardens Cemetery was once a peaceful resting place. Now it is an active burial site crawling with restless skeletons and reanimated spellcasters. The Night Watch is stretched thin along Duskwood’s borders, so Commander Ebonlocke directs arriving travelers to strike down Skeletal Warriors and Skeletal Mages before the dead spill onto the roads.

faq.q: Why does the Night Watch need outside help?
faq.answer: Stormwind recalled its official garrison from Duskwood, leaving Darkshire to fend for itself. The Night Watch is a local militia without the people or supplies to fight the undead across the whole territory without help.

Althea Ebonlocke is a relative of Darkshire’s mayor, Lord Ello Ebonlocke, and commands the Night Watch. She organizes the town’s defenses and rallies anyone able to stand against Duskwood’s dark menaces.

faq.q: Where is the Tranquil Gardens Cemetery?
faq.answer: Tranquil Gardens Cemetery lies just south of Darkshire. It remains an active burial site, but dark magic in Duskwood has caused the dead to rise and harass travelers near the town’s edge.

faq.q: What creatures are rising in the Tranquil Gardens?
faq.answer: Animated Skeletal Warriors and Skeletal Mages overrun the cemetery. Unlike ordinary corpses, these remains retain martial skill and arcane power, making them a lethal threat to common townfolk.
No. Stormwind withdrew its commissioned guards, leaving remote Duskwood to fend for itself.

faq.q: Does this assignment end the threat at the cemetery?
faq.answer: No. Clearing skeletons from Tranquil Gardens is only the first effort. The Night Watch faces growing threats deeper in the woods, and further expeditions are needed to manage Duskwood’s worsening corruption.

angles.text: For Alliance loyalists, this duty reveals Stormwind’s neglect: frontier citizens must fight for their own survival without royal aid.
As a paladin, you face an affront to the Light at Tranquil Gardens, where desecrated graves call for consecrated steel and righteous judgment.
As a priest, you can lay tormented, restless skeletons to rest as an act of spiritual mercy in a land under sinister curses.
